open_points.subject: A13 rule 6 mapped-node value-list persistence
open_points.text: written when the list is first delivered — never in an element's own store change
open_points.question: Which component and store change is responsible for writing the mapped node's delivered value list?
options: The run executor writes it in a dedicated store call before delivery
The store change that records the first receiving node writes it
The store change that records a flow output writes it when the first recipient is a flow output
A shared store operation writes it regardless of the kind of first recipient
open_points.default_guess: Have the run executor invoke one shared store operation to write the list before any recipient is updated or executed.
